source.author: ov
source.text: Pyramus et Thisbe, iuvenum pulcherrimus alter, altera, quas oriens habuit, praelata puellis, contiguas tenuere domos, ubi dicitur altam coctilibus muris cinxisse Semiramis urbem.
source.text_original: 'Pyramus et Thisbe, iuvenum pulcherrimus alter, / altera, quas oriens habuit, praelata puellis, / contiguas tenuere domos, ubi dicitur altam / coctilibus muris cinxisse Semiramis urbem.
source.text_english: Pyramus and Thisbe, he the most handsome of the young men, she the fairest of the girls whom the East had produced, occupied adjoining houses, where Semiramis is said to have surrounded the lofty city with baked-brick walls.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Hujus uxor Semiramis, de qua multa et miranda referuntur, muros Babylonis exstruxit: de qua insignis poeta testatur dicens: Quam dicitur olim Coctilibus maris cinxisse Semiramis urbem.
reuse.text_original: Hujus uxor Semiramis, de qua multa et miranda referuntur, muros Babylonis exstruxit: de qua insignis poeta testatur dicens: Quam dicitur olim Coctilibus maris cinxisse Semiramis urbem.
reuse.text_english: His wife Semiramis, about whom many marvelous things are reported, built the walls of Babylon; and of her a famous poet bears witness, saying: Semiramis, as it is said, once surrounded the city with baked bricks.
